layer.placement: One world-fixed flock plane at 12 camera-forward units, in front of all frozen mountain bands and above the skyline; imported approved goose mesh is rotated in shader to face the camera while crossing.
layer.occlusion: Normal opaque depth testing stays enabled. Every installed mountain vertex is projected on camera forward to report the exact minimum depth and front-of-mountain margin.
layer.camera: Read only; initial frozen camera basis is copied to the component transform. Neither camera nor frozen scenery is changed.
layer.quiet_schedule: A nine-second crossing followed by 87 seconds without a flock. Every bird has an independent flap phase and a brief glide in each wing cycle.
layer.freeze: No TIME, process callback, tween, physics or random update; all movement uses externally supplied anim_t. B repeats the exact same time and geometry.
layer.frustum_clipping: Custom AABB expanded for x crossing -12..14, y sky band and z depth ±asset extent; static instance origin remains inside AABB for the full crossing.
layer.source_model: Approved four-view reference -> Blender editable source -> goose_lowpoly_export.glb; one MultiMeshInstance3D uses the imported mesh.
